question: What claim is being made here about the speaker's present desire with respect to the worship of the siddhas?
premises: The worship of the siddhas is in question.
The speaker wishes to hear it now.
The source of hearing is from the gurus.
inference: The speaker now wishes to hear about the worship of the siddhas from the gurus.
uncertainties: Whether this desire has been fulfilled is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear from the gurus about the worship of the siddhas.
